This final context is used to generate the global answer returned to the user. To evaluate the effectiveness of RAG systems for global sensemaking tasks, we use an LLM to generate a set of corpus-specific questions designed to asses high-level understanding of a given

bridge-topic into a claim set. We restrict the claim
set to have at least two claims but no more than four
claims. For each type of query, we feed the claim
set to GPT-4 and prompt it with an instruction to
generate a query with information from each claim.
